main.title: US unveils proposed tariffs on major partners, including EU and China
main.summary: The United States on Wednesday unveiled proposed tariffs on 14 economies including the European Union and China, after a months-long probe into alleged excess production -- the latest move by US President Donald Trump to remake Washington's trade relationships. The duties, proposed at up to 20 percent, come over allegations the economies "are promoting production and capacity divorced from the realities of demand and market principles," a senior US official said on condition of anonymity. FRANCE

related.title: EU says 'strongly' rejects premise of new US tariffs
related.summary: The EU said Wednesday that it rejected the premise of new tariffs on its exports proposed by the United States and expected Washington to stick by a deal struck with Brussels last year. The US unveiled proposed tariffs on 14 economies including the European Union and China, after a months-long probe into alleged excess production. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels.

2230122329.topic: USA propongono nuovi dazi su 14 economie, UE e Cina incluse
2230122329.reason: I nuovi dazi USA proposti contro UE e Cina toccano direttamente l'export italiano: Bruxelles li respinge "con forza" e chiede a Washington di rispettare l'accordo dell'anno scorso. Ne parlano più testate e la notizia pesa anche sui mercati.
